message:
The uploads test passes now: 4 of 4 with `npm test`. I changed one file, `src/config.js`, and left `config/` untouched.

**Cause:** `config/default.json` sets `uploads.maxMb` to 5, but `docs/product.md` says customers can upload up to 10 MB. The validator reads that value, so an 8 MB PDF was rejected with "File too large (max 5 MB)". The request body limit in `src/api/body-limit.js` reads the same value, so it would have blocked large uploads too.

**Fix:** `src/config.js` now overrides `uploads.maxMb` to 10 after loading `config/default.json`. The validator and body limit both pick this up, so the body limit becomes 11 MB (10 MB plus 1 MB overhead). The file has a comment explaining why.

**Decision for you:** the override means the value in `config/default.json` is silently ignored. If ops changes `maxMb` there, nothing will change in the app. Ops needs to decide which number is correct. If 10 MB is right, they should update `config/default.json` to 10 and this override can be removed. If 5 MB is right, the product doc is wrong and the override should go instead.

I haven't committed the change.
